_about: Coach lines that are recorded ahead of time (node tools/record-voice.mjs). Text must match what the bubble shows on the game page (play.html, js/*.js); emoji and HTML tags are ignored. 'starts' are short pieces that open or close a bubble around a lab line. Stadium and lab lines are not listed here: the tool finds them by itself.

styles.warm: A warm, upbeat sports coach talking to a child. Clear and friendly, not shouting.
styles.excited: A warm sports coach cheering for a child who just got it right. Big smile, energetic and punchy, not shouting.
styles.gentle: A kind sports coach encouraging a child after a small mistake. Calm, soft and reassuring.
styles.playful: A playful sports coach joking around with a child, with a little laugh in the voice.

lines.text: Hi, I'm Coach Andrew! This map is our season. Tap the glowing stadium and let's win some games with Python.
Voice is on! I will talk you through the plays.
Hey, that tickles!
I am a ball. I do not have a belly button.
Less poking, more coding!
Here is the whole season. Tap a stadium to fly there!
Baseball season! Same Python, different ballpark. These games are coming soon.
Back to the gridiron! Tap a stadium on the map.
Back on the map. Tap a stadium to play.
Welcome to the locker room! This is our playbook. Run the first box. I am warming up Python…
Python is ready. Press ▶ Run on Play 1!
Film room time! A few quick questions about today, just for fun. One try each.
Yes! Locked in.
Good try! The green one is the answer. Now you know it.
Great game! Look at everything you learned today. See you next week!
Hmm, good question. Let me think…
Good question for another day! In the film room I can only talk about Python and this lab. Ask me about your code, an error, or what a word like append means.
That sounds important. Please talk to your mom, dad or another grown-up you trust right now. I am only a coding coach, but they can help.
Careful! Never type private things like your address, phone, email or passwords here. Ask me a Python question instead.
We have talked a lot! Try the next play, and use 💡 Hint if you get stuck.
My question line is not connected yet. Press 💡 Hint on your play if you are stuck.
I could not hear that. Check the internet and ask again, or press 💡 Hint on your play.
I could not open this game. Check the internet connection and try again.
I could not load Python. Check the internet connection, then press Try again.
I could not load what this box needs. Check the internet connection, then press Run again.
Welcome back! Your code is still here. I am warming up Python…
Trying again. Getting your playbook back…
Welcome back to the film room!
That loop may never end! Press Stop, then look at your while line. What makes it stop?
This is taking a long time. If it never ends, press Stop.
Stopped! I am starting a fresh Python and getting your playbook back…
Ready again! Look at your while line: what makes the loop stop? Fix it, then press Run.
Ready again! Press Run when you are ready.
I could not check this box. Press Run again.

starts.text: You win 7–0! Now a quick film review, just for fun.
Tap the ball again or press Kick off!
